name: operations
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && LAB_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-m/member-premises-variant.ts flags && LAB_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-m/operation-step-variant.ts && bun run check && bunx commitlint --default-config < replays/commit-message.txt && work=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/track-m-operation-models-XXXXXX") && trap 'bash research/track-m/pack-section18-archive.sh "$work"' EXIT && for op in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6; do GDP_COUNTS_DUMP_ALL_PASSES=1 bun research/track-m/operation-models.ts replays/family.json "$op" "$work/op$op"; done
